blocks.text: The chemical and physical properties of water are central to studying the nature and extent of pollution in the water bodies. The water molecule (H₂O) is a permanent dipole. This polarity renders water unique properties essential for life and the environment. Some peculiar features of water that emerge from its structure are discussed here.
